description: Refine a layer mask's edges as Select and Mask does, writing the result back to the layer mask. Without a mask, the current selection is refined into a new mask

radius.description: Edge detection radius in pixels. Default 0

shiftEdge.description: Percent; negative moves the edge in. Default 0

target.description: One layer. Default the active layer

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

name: refine_mask
title: Refine Mask
